lpp.ach_return.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.ach_return.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each ACH return record.

lpp.ach_return.original_transfer_ref.name: original_transfer_ref
lpp.ach_return.original_transfer_ref.description: UUID reference identifying the original ACH transfer that was returned.

lpp.ach_return.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.ach_return.company_ref.description: Code identifying the legal entity or company associated with the ACH return, such as GR_GB (Great Britain entity) or GR_US_INC (US incorporated entity).

lpp.ach_return.business_unit_code.name: business_unit_code
lpp.ach_return.business_unit_code.description: Code identifying the business unit responsible for the ACH return, such as BU_GB (Great Britain business unit) or BU_USINC_PAYROLL (US Inc payroll unit).
value_aliases: BU_USINC_PAYROLL -> US Inc payroll business unit

lpp.ach_return.return_date.name: return_date
lpp.ach_return.return_date.description: Calendar date on which the ACH return was received or processed.

lpp.ach_return.return_reason_code.name: return_reason_code
lpp.ach_return.return_reason_code.description: NACHA standard ACH return reason code indicating why the transfer was returned, such as R01 (insufficient funds) or R02 (account closed).
value_aliases: R03 -> No account / unable to locate account
R29 -> Corporate customer advises not authorized

lpp.ach_return.return_category.name: return_category
lpp.ach_return.return_category.description: High-level business category grouping the reason for the ACH return, such as INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS, INVALID_ACCT, UNAUTHORIZED, or OTHER.

lpp.ach_return.direction.name: direction
lpp.ach_return.direction.description: Direction of the ACH return transaction, indicating whether funds are debited from or credited to the company's account; currently always DEBIT.

lpp.ach_return.amount.name: amount
lpp.ach_return.amount.description: Monetary value of the returned ACH transaction in the associated currency.

lpp.ach_return.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.ach_return.currency_code.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the returned transaction, such as USD, EUR, or GBP.

lpp.ach_return.bank_account_ref.name: bank_account_ref
lpp.ach_return.bank_account_ref.description: Internal reference code identifying the company bank account associated with the ACH return, including entity and account purpose such as GR_GB_OPERATING_1 or GR_US_INC_PAYROLL_1.

lpp.ach_return.resolved.name: resolved
lpp.ach_return.resolved.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the ACH return has been resolved or actioned by the operations team.

lpp.acquirer.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.acquirer.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each acquirer record.

lpp.acquirer.code.name: code
lpp.acquirer.code.description: Short internal code identifying the payment acquirer (e.g. ADYEN, STRIPE, FIS_WORLDPAY).
value_aliases: BANK_OF_AMERICA_MS -> Bank of America Merchant Services

lpp.acquirer.name.name: name
lpp.acquirer.name.description: Full legal or trade name of the payment acquirer (e.g. Adyen NV, Stripe Payments, FIS Worldpay).

lpp.acquirer.bank_ref.name: bank_ref
lpp.acquirer.bank_ref.description: Internal reference code identifying the parent or sponsoring bank associated with this acquirer, where applicable (e.g. BANK_BAC for Bank of America, BANK_JPM for JPMorgan).

lpp.acquirer.settlement_account_ref.name: settlement_account_ref
lpp.acquirer.settlement_account_ref.description: Internal reference code identifying the settlement account through which funds from this acquirer are reconciled (e.g. USA_RGNL_OPERATING, EUR_RGNL_OPERATING).
value_aliases: GR_US_INC_OP_4 -> GR US Inc Operating Account 4

lpp.acquirer.region.name: region
lpp.acquirer.region.description: Geographic region in which the acquirer operates, using standard regional codes (e.g. AMER for Americas, EMEA for Europe/Middle East/Africa).

lpp.acquirer.is_strategic.name: is_strategic
lpp.acquirer.is_strategic.description: Flag indicating whether this acquirer is designated as a strategic partner for the business.

lpp.acquirer.onboarded_date.name: onboarded_date
lpp.acquirer.onboarded_date.description: Calendar date on which the acquirer was formally onboarded and activated within the platform.

lpp.acquirer_contract.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.acquirer_contract.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each acquirer contract record.

lpp.acquirer_contract.acquirer_ref.name: acquirer_ref
lpp.acquirer_contract.acquirer_ref.description: Coded reference identifying the payment acquirer or processor party to the contract, e.g. ADYEN, STRIPE, FIS_WORLDPAY.
value_aliases: BANK_OF_AMERICA_MS -> Bank of America Merchant Services

lpp.acquirer_contract.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.acquirer_contract.company_ref.description: Coded reference identifying the internal legal entity that is party to the acquirer contract, e.g. GR_US_INC, GR_EU_BV.

lpp.acquirer_contract.effective_from.name: effective_from
lpp.acquirer_contract.effective_from.description: Calendar date on which the acquirer contract becomes active and its terms take effect.

lpp.acquirer_contract.effective_to.name: effective_to
lpp.acquirer_contract.effective_to.description: Calendar date on which the acquirer contract expires or is terminated; null indicates an open-ended contract.

lpp.acquirer_contract.contract_status.name: contract_status
lpp.acquirer_contract.contract_status.description: Current lifecycle status of the acquirer contract, indicating whether it is active or otherwise.

lpp.acquirer_contract.processor_margin_b.name: processor_margin_bps
lpp.acquirer_contract.processor_margin_b.description: The acquirer's processing margin expressed in basis points charged on transactions under this contract.

lpp.acquirer_contract.monthly_minimum_am.name: monthly_minimum_amount
lpp.acquirer_contract.monthly_minimum_am.description: Minimum monetary amount the company is contractually obligated to pay the acquirer each month.

lpp.acquirer_contract.monthly_minimum_cu.name: monthly_minimum_currency
lpp.acquirer_contract.monthly_minimum_cu.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the monthly minimum amount is denominated, e.g. USD, EUR, GBP.

lpp.acquirer_contract.settlement_lag_bus.name: settlement_lag_business_days
lpp.acquirer_contract.settlement_lag_bus.description: Number of business days of lag between transaction processing and the acquirer initiating settlement of funds.

lpp.acquirer_contract.uptime_sla_pct.name: uptime_sla_pct
lpp.acquirer_contract.uptime_sla_pct.description: Contractually guaranteed minimum platform uptime availability for the acquirer, expressed as a percentage.

lpp.acquirer_contract.auth_response_sla_.name: auth_response_sla_ms
lpp.acquirer_contract.auth_response_sla_.description: Maximum authorisation response time guaranteed by the acquirer under the contract's SLA, measured in milliseconds.

lpp.acquirer_contract.settlement_sla_bus.name: settlement_sla_business_days
lpp.acquirer_contract.settlement_sla_bus.description: Maximum number of business days within which the acquirer is contractually required to complete settlement of funds.

lpp.acquirer_contract.renewal_notice_day.name: renewal_notice_days
lpp.acquirer_contract.renewal_notice_day.description: Number of days advance notice required before contract expiry to trigger or prevent automatic renewal.

lpp.acquirer_contract.auto_renew.name: auto_renew
lpp.acquirer_contract.auto_renew.description: Flag indicating whether the acquirer contract automatically renews at expiry without requiring explicit renegotiation.

lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier assigned to each SLA metric record for deduplication and system-level tracking.

lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.acquirer_ref.name: acquirer_ref
lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.acquirer_ref.description: Short code identifying the payment acquirer or processor whose SLA metrics are being measured (e.g. STRIPE, ADYEN, FISERV).
value_aliases: BANK_OF_AMERICA_MS -> Bank of America Merchant Services

lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.measurement_date.name: measurement_date
lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.measurement_date.description: Calendar date on which the acquirer SLA metrics were measured or reported.

lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.auth_rate_pct.name: auth_rate_pct
lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.auth_rate_pct.description: Percentage of payment authorisation attempts that were successfully approved by the acquirer on the measurement date.

lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.avg_response_tim.name: avg_response_time_ms
lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.avg_response_tim.description: Average time in milliseconds the acquirer took to respond to authorisation requests on the measurement date.

lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.settlement_on_ti.name: settlement_on_time_pct
lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.settlement_on_ti.description: Percentage of settlements completed by the acquirer within the contractually agreed settlement deadline.

lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.uptime_pct.name: uptime_pct
lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.uptime_pct.description: Percentage of time the acquirer's processing system was available and operational during the measurement period.

lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.sla_breach_count.name: sla_breach_count
lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.sla_breach_count.description: Number of SLA breaches recorded for the acquirer on the measurement date.

lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.incident_count.name: incident_count
lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.incident_count.description: Number of operational incidents raised against the acquirer on the measurement date.

lpp.ap_invoice.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.ap_invoice.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier that serves as the primary key for each accounts payable invoice record.

lpp.ap_invoice.invoice_number.name: invoice_number
lpp.ap_invoice.invoice_number.description: Human-readable AP invoice reference number assigned at invoice creation, formatted as AP-XXXXXXXX.

lpp.ap_invoice.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.ap_invoice.company_ref.description: Internal code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary within the group that received and owns this invoice (e.g. GR_CA = Canada entity, GR_TREASURY = treasury entity).

lpp.ap_invoice.vendor_ref.name: vendor_ref
lpp.ap_invoice.vendor_ref.description: Internal code identifying the vendor or supplier who issued the invoice, prefixed by spend category (e.g. TP_CAPEX, TP_IT, TP_MKTG).

lpp.ap_invoice.issue_date.name: issue_date
lpp.ap_invoice.issue_date.description: Calendar date on which the invoice was issued by the vendor.

lpp.ap_invoice.due_date.name: due_date
lpp.ap_invoice.due_date.description: Calendar date by which the invoice must be paid according to the agreed payment terms.

lpp.ap_invoice.paid_date.name: paid_date
lpp.ap_invoice.paid_date.description: Calendar date on which the invoice was fully or partially paid; null indicates the invoice has not yet been paid.

lpp.ap_invoice.invoice_amount.name: invoice_amount
lpp.ap_invoice.invoice_amount.description: Total gross monetary amount billed on the invoice in the invoice currency.

lpp.ap_invoice.paid_amount.name: paid_amount
lpp.ap_invoice.paid_amount.description: Total monetary amount that has been paid against this invoice to date, in the invoice currency.

lpp.ap_invoice.open_amount.name: open_amount
lpp.ap_invoice.open_amount.description: Remaining unpaid monetary balance on the invoice (invoice amount minus paid amount), in the invoice currency.

lpp.ap_invoice.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.ap_invoice.currency_code.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the invoice amounts are denominated (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP).

lpp.ap_invoice.status.name: status
lpp.ap_invoice.status.description: Current payment status of the invoice indicating whether it is fully paid, open and unpaid, partially paid, or under dispute.

lpp.ap_invoice.payment_terms.name: payment_terms
lpp.ap_invoice.payment_terms.description: Agreed payment terms code specifying when payment is due relative to the invoice date (e.g. NET_30 = due 30 days after invoice, EOM_5 = due 5 days after end of month).
value_aliases: EOM_5 -> 5 days after end of month

lpp.app_user.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.app_user.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each application user record.

lpp.app_user.code.name: code
lpp.app_user.code.description: Alphanumeric role or job function code assigned to the user, representing their business role within the treasury and finance organisation (e.g. TREAS_FRONT, CFO_GLOBAL, FX_TRADER).

lpp.app_user.first_name.name: first_name
lpp.app_user.first_name.description: The given (first) name of the application user.

lpp.app_user.last_name.name: last_name
lpp.app_user.last_name.description: The family (last) name or surname of the application user.

lpp.app_user.email.name: email
lpp.app_user.email.description: Corporate email address of the application user (e.g. firstname.lastname@globalretail.com).

lpp.app_user.active.name: active
lpp.app_user.active.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the user account is currently active and permitted to access the application.

lpp.ar_invoice.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.ar_invoice.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier that serves as the primary key for each accounts receivable invoice record.

lpp.ar_invoice.invoice_number.name: invoice_number
lpp.ar_invoice.invoice_number.description: Human-readable invoice reference code encoding the channel, issuing entity, and date (e.g. AR-B2C-GR_AE-20230501).

lpp.ar_invoice.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.ar_invoice.company_ref.description: Internal code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary that issued the invoice (e.g. GR_AE, GR_EU_BV, GR_US_INC).

lpp.ar_invoice.customer_ref.name: customer_ref
lpp.ar_invoice.customer_ref.description: Internal code identifying the customer billed on the invoice, including retail consumers and named third-party accounts (e.g. RETAIL_CONSUMER, TP_CUST_0015).

lpp.ar_invoice.issue_date.name: issue_date
lpp.ar_invoice.issue_date.description: Calendar date on which the invoice was created and issued to the customer.

lpp.ar_invoice.due_date.name: due_date
lpp.ar_invoice.due_date.description: Calendar date by which payment of the invoice is expected, based on the agreed payment terms.

lpp.ar_invoice.paid_date.name: paid_date
lpp.ar_invoice.paid_date.description: Calendar date on which the invoice was fully settled; null if the invoice has not yet been paid.

lpp.ar_invoice.invoice_amount.name: invoice_amount
lpp.ar_invoice.invoice_amount.description: Total monetary value billed on the invoice in the invoice currency.

lpp.ar_invoice.paid_amount.name: paid_amount
lpp.ar_invoice.paid_amount.description: Total monetary value received in payment against the invoice in the invoice currency.

lpp.ar_invoice.open_amount.name: open_amount
lpp.ar_invoice.open_amount.description: Remaining unpaid balance on the invoice in the invoice currency, representing the difference between the invoice amount and payments received.

lpp.ar_invoice.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.ar_invoice.currency_code.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the invoice amounts are denominated (e.g. USD, EUR, JPY).

lpp.ar_invoice.status.name: status
lpp.ar_invoice.status.description: Current collection status of the invoice, indicating whether it has been paid, remains open, or has been written off.

lpp.ar_invoice.payment_terms.name: payment_terms
lpp.ar_invoice.payment_terms.description: Agreed number of days from invoice issue date within which payment is due (e.g. NET_30 = payment due within 30 days, NET_0 = due immediately).

lpp.audit_trail.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.audit_trail.uuid.description: Unique identifier for each audit trail event record.

lpp.audit_trail.entity_type.name: entity_type
lpp.audit_trail.entity_type.description: Category of the business object that was acted upon, such as a bank account, transfer, hedge relationship, or liquidity policy.

lpp.audit_trail.entity_code.name: entity_code
lpp.audit_trail.entity_code.description: Business identifier of the specific entity instance that was acted upon, such as a bank account or transfer reference code.

lpp.audit_trail.action.name: action
lpp.audit_trail.action.description: Type of operation performed on the entity during the audited event, such as creating, updating, or approving a record.

lpp.audit_trail.actor_user.name: actor_user
lpp.audit_trail.actor_user.description: Username or role of the system user who performed the audited action.

lpp.audit_trail.occurred_at.name: occurred_at
lpp.audit_trail.occurred_at.description: Timestamp with timezone indicating when the audited action took place.

lpp.audit_trail.before_image.name: before_image
lpp.audit_trail.before_image.description: Full snapshot of the entity's data state immediately before the audited action was applied.

lpp.audit_trail.after_image.name: after_image
lpp.audit_trail.after_image.description: Full snapshot of the entity's data state immediately after the audited action was applied.

lpp.bank_account_group.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.bank_account_group.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier that serves as the primary key for each bank account group record.

lpp.bank_account_group.code.name: code
lpp.bank_account_group.code.description: Short alphanumeric code used to identify and reference a bank account group within the system.

lpp.bank_account_group.description.name: description
lpp.bank_account_group.description.description: Human-readable text label or explanation describing the purpose or nature of the bank account group.

lpp.bank_account_group_member.account_gr.name: account_group_code
lpp.bank_account_group_member.account_gr.description: Unique code identifying the bank account group to which a member belongs.

lpp.bank_account_group_member.bank_accou.name: bank_account_code
lpp.bank_account_group_member.bank_accou.description: Unique code identifying the individual bank account that is a member of the group.

lpp.bank_account_signatory.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.bank_account_signatory.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each bank account signatory record.

lpp.bank_account_signatory.bank_account_.name: bank_account_ref
lpp.bank_account_signatory.bank_account_.description: Business reference code identifying the specific bank account to which the signatory authority applies, encoding entity, country, purpose, and sequence (e.g. GR_JP_OPERATING_1).

lpp.bank_account_signatory.user_ref.name: user_ref
lpp.bank_account_signatory.user_ref.description: Business role code identifying the internal user or role granted signatory authority on the bank account (e.g. TREAS_HEAD, CFO_GLOBAL).

lpp.bank_account_signatory.role.name: role
lpp.bank_account_signatory.role.description: Signatory role assigned to the user on the bank account, defining their level of signing or payment release authority (e.g. SIGNER_A, SIGNER_B, RELEASER).

lpp.bank_account_signatory.authority_lim.name: authority_limit_amount
lpp.bank_account_signatory.authority_lim.description: Maximum monetary amount up to which the signatory is authorised to approve or sign transactions on the bank account.

lpp.bank_account_signatory.authority_lim.name: authority_limit_currency
lpp.bank_account_signatory.authority_lim.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the signatory's authority limit amount is denominated (e.g. EUR, USD, GBP).

lpp.bank_account_signatory.granted_date.name: granted_date
lpp.bank_account_signatory.granted_date.description: Calendar date on which signatory authority was formally granted to the user for the bank account.

lpp.bank_account_signatory.last_recertif.name: last_recertified_date
lpp.bank_account_signatory.last_recertif.description: Calendar date on which the signatory's authority was most recently reviewed and recertified.

lpp.bank_account_signatory.next_recertif.name: next_recertify_due_date
lpp.bank_account_signatory.next_recertif.description: Calendar date by which the signatory's authority must next be reviewed and recertified to remain valid.

lpp.bank_account_signatory.status.name: status
lpp.bank_account_signatory.status.description: Current status of the signatory's authority on the bank account, indicating whether the mandate is active or otherwise.

lpp.bank_branch.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.bank_branch.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier that serves as the primary key for each bank branch record.

lpp.bank_branch.code.name: code
lpp.bank_branch.code.description: Structured alphanumeric code uniquely identifying a bank branch, following the pattern BR_{BANK}_{CITY} (e.g. BR_ANZ_SYD, BR_JPM_LDN).

lpp.bank_branch.interface_code.name: interface_code
lpp.bank_branch.interface_code.description: External-facing branch code used by integrated systems to reference a bank branch, mirroring the internal branch code format (e.g. BR_ANZ_SYD, BR_JPM_LDN).

lpp.bank_branch.bank_ref.name: bank_ref
lpp.bank_branch.bank_ref.description: Reference code identifying the parent bank that owns this branch (e.g. BANK_HSBC, BANK_JPM), grouping branches under their institution.

lpp.bank_branch.description.name: description
lpp.bank_branch.description.description: Human-readable display name of the bank branch combining the bank name and city (e.g. "HSBC London", "JPM New York").

lpp.bank_branch.description2.name: description2
lpp.bank_branch.description2.description: Secondary or supplementary text description field for the bank branch, available for additional naming or annotation.

lpp.bank_branch.bic.name: bic
lpp.bank_branch.bic.description: SWIFT Bank Identifier Code (BIC) for the branch, used internationally to identify the bank and location for payment routing (e.g. HBUKGB4BXXX, CHASUS33XXX).

lpp.bank_branch.corp_id_code.name: corp_id_code
lpp.bank_branch.corp_id_code.description: Corporate identity code assigned to the bank branch for internal or regulatory corporate identification purposes.

lpp.bank_branch.account_location.name: account_location
lpp.bank_branch.account_location.description: Physical or operational location descriptor associated with the branch's accounts.

lpp.bank_branch.time_zone.name: time_zone
lpp.bank_branch.time_zone.description: IANA time zone identifier for the branch's local operating time zone (e.g. Europe/London, America/New_York, Asia/Singapore).

lpp.bank_branch.cut_off_time.name: cut_off_time
lpp.bank_branch.cut_off_time.description: Daily payment or transaction cut-off time (in HH:MM format, local branch time) after which instructions are processed on the next business day (e.g. 16:00, 15:30).

lpp.bank_branch.calendar_ref.name: calendar_ref
lpp.bank_branch.calendar_ref.description: Reference code identifying the business day calendar applied to the branch for determining working days and holidays (e.g. STANDARD).

lpp.bank_branch.intercompany.name: intercompany
lpp.bank_branch.intercompany.description: Flag indicating whether this bank branch is used exclusively for intercompany transactions between entities within the same corporate group.

lpp.bank_branch.intermediary.name: intermediary
lpp.bank_branch.intermediary.description: Flag indicating whether this bank branch acts as an intermediary (correspondent bank) in payment chains.

lpp.bank_branch.main_country_branch.name: main_country_branch
lpp.bank_branch.main_country_branch.description: Flag indicating whether this is the primary branch of the bank within its country, as opposed to a secondary or regional branch.

lpp.bank_branch.responder_code.name: responder_code
lpp.bank_branch.responder_code.description: Code identifying the branch as a responder entity in a messaging or communication framework (e.g. SWIFT messaging hierarchy).

lpp.bank_branch.id_of_application.name: id_of_application
lpp.bank_branch.id_of_application.description: Identifier of the application or system instance associated with this bank branch for integration or connectivity purposes.

lpp.bank_branch.service_name.name: service_name
lpp.bank_branch.service_name.description: Name of the banking service or product offering associated with this branch.

lpp.bank_branch.interact_service_name.name: interact_service_name
lpp.bank_branch.interact_service_name.description: Name of the interactive or messaging service used by this branch for interbank or client-facing communications.

lpp.bank_branch.memo.name: memo
lpp.bank_branch.memo.description: Free-text memo or internal note field for capturing ad hoc remarks or comments about the bank branch.

lpp.bank_branch.address.name: address
lpp.bank_branch.address.description: Structured JSON/semi-structured object storing the physical address details of the bank branch.

lpp.bank_branch.contact.name: contact
lpp.bank_branch.contact.description: Structured JSON/semi-structured object storing contact details (such as phone, email, or contact person) for the bank branch.

lpp.bank_branch.other_identifier.name: other_identifier
lpp.bank_branch.other_identifier.description: Structured JSON/semi-structured object holding additional or alternative identifiers for the branch beyond the primary code and BIC.

lpp.bank_branch.user_zone.name: user_zone
lpp.bank_branch.user_zone.description: Structured JSON/semi-structured object capturing user-defined custom attributes or zone classifications specific to the branch.

lpp.bank_branch.country_code.name: country_code
lpp.bank_branch.country_code.description: ISO 2-letter country code representing the country where the bank branch is located (e.g. GB, US, SG, AE).

lpp.bank_branch.region.name: region
lpp.bank_branch.region.description: Geographic region grouping for the branch, such as EMEA, APAC, AMER, LATAM, or MENA.

lpp.bank_fee.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.bank_fee.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each bank fee record.

lpp.bank_fee.bank_ref.name: bank_ref
lpp.bank_fee.bank_ref.description: Short code identifying the bank that issued the fee (e.g. BANK_CITI, BANK_JPM, BANK_HSBC).

lpp.bank_fee.bank_account_ref.name: bank_account_ref
lpp.bank_fee.bank_account_ref.description: Structured reference code identifying the specific bank account associated with the fee, encoding entity, country, and account type (e.g. GR_GB_OPERATING_1, GR_US_INC_COLLECTION_1).

lpp.bank_fee.service_code.name: service_code
lpp.bank_fee.service_code.description: Numeric code identifying the type of banking service for which the fee was charged (e.g. 100, 260, 270, 271, 251, 300).

lpp.bank_fee.statement_period.name: statement_period
lpp.bank_fee.statement_period.description: Last date of the monthly billing period covered by the bank fee statement (e.g. 2024-07-31 represents July 2024).

lpp.bank_fee.charge_date.name: charge_date
lpp.bank_fee.charge_date.description: Calendar date on which the bank fee was actually charged or debited.

lpp.bank_fee.units.name: units
lpp.bank_fee.units.description: Quantity of service units consumed or processed that the fee is based on for the billing period.

lpp.bank_fee.charged_amount.name: charged_amount
lpp.bank_fee.charged_amount.description: Actual monetary amount charged by the bank for the service in the billing period, expressed in the stated currency.

lpp.bank_fee.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.bank_fee.currency_code.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the fee amounts are denominated (currently always USD).

lpp.bank_fee.cash_flow_ref.name: cash_flow_ref
lpp.bank_fee.cash_flow_ref.description: UUID reference to the cash flow transaction record associated with this bank fee payment.

lpp.bank_statement_balance.statement_dat.name: statement_date

lpp.benchmark_rate.currency_code.name: currency_code

lpp.benchmark_rate.source.name: source

lpp.borrowing.uuid.name: uuid

lpp.borrowing.facility_ref.name: facility_ref
lpp.borrowing.facility_ref.description: Internal reference code identifying the credit facility (e.g. term loan, revolving credit facility, intercompany, overdraft) under which the borrowing was made, including currency and size indicators.

lpp.borrowing.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.borrowing.company_ref.description: Internal reference code identifying the group entity (subsidiary or holding company) that is the borrower on this record.

lpp.borrowing.drawdown_date.name: drawdown_date

lpp.borrowing.repayment_date.name: repayment_date

lpp.borrowing.all_in_rate.description: Total annualised interest rate (in percent) applicable to the borrowing, inclusive of margin, base rate, and any applicable fees.

lpp.borrowing.status.name: status

lpp.brain_evaluation.uuid.name: uuid

lpp.brain_evaluation.evaluated_at.description: Timestamp recording when the brain evaluation was executed.

lpp.brain_evaluation.facts_applied.name: facts_applied

lpp.brain_evaluation.edges_traversed.name: edges_traversed

lpp.brain_evaluation.flagged_conflicts.name: flagged_conflicts
lpp.brain_evaluation.flagged_conflicts.description: Structured list of contradictions or conflicts detected among the facts or rules during the evaluation.

lpp.brain_evaluation.answer_summary.name: answer_summary
lpp.brain_evaluation.answer_summary.description: Human-readable summary of the reasoning engine's answer or conclusion produced by the evaluation.

lpp.brain_evaluation.seed_facts.name: seed_facts

lpp.brain_evaluation.retrieval_scores.name: retrieval_scores
lpp.brain_evaluation.retrieval_scores.description: Structured set of relevance or confidence scores assigned to facts or documents retrieved during the evaluation.

lpp.brain_evaluation.expansion_hops.name: expansion_hops

lpp.capital_allocation_actual.framework_.name: framework_target_pct

lpp.card_authorization.transaction_size_.name: transaction_size_band

lpp.card_authorization.region.name: region

lpp.card_authorization.auth_3ds_status.name: auth_3ds_status

lpp.cash_balance.account_ref.name: account_ref

lpp.cash_balance.balance_date.name: balance_date

lpp.cash_balance.date_basis.name: date_basis

lpp.cash_balance.includes_actual.name: includes_actual

lpp.cash_balance.includes_intraday.name: includes_intraday

lpp.cash_balance.includes_confirmed.name: includes_confirmed

lpp.cash_balance.includes_estimated.name: includes_estimated
lpp.cash_balance.includes_estimated.description: Flag indicating whether the balance includes estimated (forecast or projected) transactions.

lpp.cash_balance.amount.name: amount
lpp.cash_balance.amount.description: Monetary cash balance value for the account on the given date, expressed in the account's currency.

lpp.cash_balance.currency_code.name: currency_code

lpp.cash_balance.cash_flow_status.name: cash_flow_status

lpp.cash_flow.uuid.name: uuid

DISB_AP_RTP -> Accounts payable disbursement via RTP

lpp.cash_flow.budget_code_ref.name: budget_code_ref
lpp.cash_flow.budget_code_ref.description: Budget category code classifying the cash flow into a high-level financial planning bucket (e.g. operations, treasury, tax, capital expenditure).

lpp.cash_flow.status.name: status
lpp.cash_flow.status.description: Indicates whether the cash flow is an actual confirmed transaction or a forward-looking forecast.

lpp.cash_flow.transaction_date.name: transaction_date
lpp.cash_flow.transaction_date.description: Calendar date on which the cash flow transaction was initiated or recorded.

lpp.cash_flow.value_date.name: value_date
lpp.cash_flow.value_date.description: Calendar date on which the funds are actually credited or debited and become effective in the account.

lpp.cash_flow.update_date_time.name: update_date_time
lpp.cash_flow.update_date_time.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the cash flow record.

lpp.cash_flow.flow_amount.name: flow_amount
lpp.cash_flow.flow_amount.description: Monetary amount of the cash flow expressed in the flow's original transaction currency.

lpp.cash_flow.flow_currency.name: flow_currency
lpp.cash_flow.flow_currency.description: ISO 3-letter currency code of the original transaction currency in which the cash flow amount is denominated.

lpp.cash_flow.signed_amount.name: signed_amount
lpp.cash_flow.signed_amount.description: Flow amount with a positive or negative sign applied to indicate the direction of the cash movement (inflow positive, outflow negative) in the flow currency.

lpp.cash_flow.account_amount.name: account_amount
lpp.cash_flow.account_amount.description: Monetary value of the cash flow converted into and expressed in the account's local currency.

lpp.cash_flow.account_currency.name: account_currency
lpp.cash_flow.account_currency.description: ISO 3-letter currency code of the bank account in which the cash flow is settled and reported.

lpp.cash_flow.fx_rate.name: fx_rate
lpp.cash_flow.fx_rate.description: Exchange rate used to convert the flow amount from the transaction currency into the account's local currency.

lpp.cash_flow.counterparty_name.name: counterparty_name
lpp.cash_flow.counterparty_name.description: Display name of the external or internal party on the other side of the cash flow transaction (e.g. vendor, retail consumer, payment service provider).

lpp.cash_flow.counterparty_ref.name: counterparty_ref
lpp.cash_flow.counterparty_ref.description: Structured reference code uniquely identifying the counterparty entity (e.g. a payment service provider, capital expenditure vendor, or customer).

lpp.cash_flow.description.name: description
lpp.cash_flow.description.description: Free-text narrative describing the nature or purpose of the cash flow transaction (e.g. 'Daily POS aggregated receipts', 'Monthly rent', 'FX forward buy leg').

lpp.cash_flow.reference.name: reference
lpp.cash_flow.reference.description: Unique UUID-format reference string identifying the source transaction or originating system record for traceability.

lpp.cash_flow.user_zones.name: user_zones
lpp.cash_flow.user_zones.description: Semi-structured data capturing the access control zones or user-defined segments associated with the cash flow record.

lpp.cash_flow.payment_rail.name: payment_rail
lpp.cash_flow.payment_rail.description: Payment network or clearing mechanism used to execute the cash flow (e.g. WIRE, ACH, SEPA, RTP).

lpp.cash_flow_code.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.cash_flow_code.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each cash flow code record.

lpp.cash_flow_code.code.name: code
lpp.cash_flow_code.code.description: Short alphanumeric code classifying the type of cash flow transaction, such as RCPT_POS (point-of-sale receipt), DISB_RENT (rent disbursement), or IC_FUNDING_IN (intercompany funding inflow).

lpp.cash_flow_code.description.name: description
lpp.cash_flow_code.description.description: Human-readable label explaining the business meaning of the cash flow code, such as 'POS retail receipts', 'Rent', or 'Intercompany funding-in'.

lpp.cash_flow_code.sign.name: sign
lpp.cash_flow_code.sign.description: Indicates the direction of the cash flow, where IN represents money received and OUT represents money paid out.

lpp.cash_flow_code.category.name: category
lpp.cash_flow_code.category.description: Cash flow statement category classifying whether the transaction relates to operating, investing, or financing activities, corresponding to standard financial reporting classifications.

lpp.chargeback.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.chargeback.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each chargeback record.

lpp.chargeback.authorization_ref.description: UUID reference to the original payment authorization that is being disputed in this chargeback.

lpp.chargeback.acquirer_ref.name: acquirer_ref
lpp.chargeback.acquirer_ref.description: Code identifying the acquiring bank or payment processor that handled the original transaction (e.g., STRIPE, ADYEN, FISERV).

lpp.chargeback.network_code.name: network_code

lpp.chargeback.company_ref.name: company_ref

lpp.chargeback.location_code.name: location_code
lpp.chargeback.location_code.description: Structured code identifying the warehouse or fulfilment location associated with the disputed transaction (e.g., WH_US_0013 = US warehouse #13).

lpp.chargeback.reason_code.name: reason_code
lpp.chargeback.reason_code.description: Card-network-specific numeric reason code indicating the official grounds for the chargeback (e.g., Visa code 10.4 for fraud, Mastercard code 4855 for goods not received).

13.3 -> Visa: Not as Described or Defective Merchandise
4855 -> Mastercard: Goods or Services Not Provided

lpp.chargeback.reason_category.name: reason_category
lpp.chargeback.reason_category.description: High-level business category grouping the chargeback reason (e.g., FRAUD, NON_RECEIPT, DUPLICATE).

lpp.chargeback.initiated_date.name: initiated_date
lpp.chargeback.initiated_date.description: Calendar date on which the chargeback dispute was formally initiated by the cardholder or issuing bank.

lpp.chargeback.resolved_date.name: resolved_date
lpp.chargeback.resolved_date.description: Calendar date on which the chargeback dispute was fully resolved (won, lost, or otherwise closed).

lpp.chargeback.amount.name: amount
lpp.chargeback.amount.description: Monetary value of the disputed transaction subject to the chargeback, expressed in the associated currency.

lpp.chargeback.currency_code.name: currency_code

lpp.chargeback.status.description: Current lifecycle status of the chargeback dispute (e.g., INITIATED, REPRESENTED, WON, LOST).

LOST -> Dispute resolved in cardholder's favour

lpp.chargeback.representment_attempted.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the merchant attempted to contest the chargeback by submitting a representment.

lpp.chargeback.representment_evidence_ur.name: representment_evidence_uri
lpp.chargeback.representment_evidence_ur.description: Storage URI pointing to the PDF document bundle of evidence submitted by the merchant during representment (e.g., an S3 object path).

lpp.company.corp_id_code.name: corp_id_code

lpp.company.sepa_creditor_identifier.name: sepa_creditor_identifier

lpp.company_group_member.company_group_c.description: Proprietary code identifying the regional or structural corporate group to which a company belongs (e.g. GROUP_GLOBAL, GROUP_AMER, GROUP_EMEA, GROUP_APAC, GROUP_LATAM, GROUP_RETAIL_OPCO).

lpp.counterparty_exposure.as_of_date.name: as_of_date

lpp.counterparty_exposure.counterparty_b.name: counterparty_bank_ref
