lpp.data_permission_profile.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.data_permission_profile.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for a data permission profile record.

lpp.data_permission_profile.code.name: code
lpp.data_permission_profile.code.description: Short machine-readable code identifying a named data permission profile, encoding the scope (GLOBAL, AMER, EMEA, APAC) and access level (FULL, RW, READ) or functional role (AP_OPS, AR_OPS).

lpp.data_permission_profile.description.name: description
lpp.data_permission_profile.description.description: Human-readable explanation of the data permission profile, summarising the geographic scope and type of access granted (e.g. read/write, read-only, functional operations).

lpp.derivative_mtm.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.derivative_mtm.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier assigned to each mark-to-market record for deduplication and system-level traceability.

lpp.derivative_mtm.instrument_type.name: instrument_type
lpp.derivative_mtm.instrument_type.description: Classification of the derivative instrument being valued, e.g. FX_FORWARD indicating a foreign exchange forward contract.

lpp.derivative_mtm.instrument_ref.name: instrument_ref
lpp.derivative_mtm.instrument_ref.description: Unique business reference code identifying a specific derivative instrument, e.g. FXF-0000107 for an individual FX forward trade.

lpp.derivative_mtm.counterparty_bank_ref.name: counterparty_bank_ref
lpp.derivative_mtm.counterparty_bank_ref.description: Code identifying the external bank acting as counterparty to the derivative trade, e.g. BANK_HSBC or BANK_JPM.

lpp.derivative_mtm.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.derivative_mtm.company_ref.description: Code identifying the internal legal entity within the group that owns the derivative position, e.g. GR_EU_BV or GR_TREASURY.

lpp.derivative_mtm.valuation_date.name: valuation_date
lpp.derivative_mtm.valuation_date.description: Calendar date on which the mark-to-market valuation of the derivative instrument was calculated.

lpp.derivative_mtm.mtm_amount.name: mtm_amount
lpp.derivative_mtm.mtm_amount.description: Mark-to-market fair value of the derivative instrument as of the valuation date, expressed in the MTM currency.

lpp.derivative_mtm.mtm_currency.name: mtm_currency
lpp.derivative_mtm.mtm_currency.description: ISO 3-letter currency code in which the mark-to-market amount is denominated, e.g. USD.

lpp.equity_action.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.equity_action.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each equity action record.

lpp.equity_action.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.equity_action.company_ref.description: Internal code identifying the company that initiated the equity action.

lpp.equity_action.action_type.name: action_type
lpp.equity_action.action_type.description: Category of corporate equity action taken, such as a share buyback, regular dividend, or special dividend.

lpp.equity_action.action_date.name: action_date
lpp.equity_action.action_date.description: Calendar date on which the equity action was executed or declared.

lpp.equity_action.settle_date.name: settle_date
lpp.equity_action.settle_date.description: Calendar date on which the equity action financially settles and funds or shares are transferred.

lpp.equity_action.shares.name: shares
lpp.equity_action.shares.description: Number of shares involved in the equity action, such as shares repurchased or shares eligible for a dividend.

lpp.equity_action.price_per_share.name: price_per_share
lpp.equity_action.price_per_share.description: Price paid or applied per individual share in the equity action.

lpp.equity_action.total_amount.name: total_amount
lpp.equity_action.total_amount.description: Total monetary value of the equity action, representing the aggregate cost or payout across all shares.

lpp.equity_action.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.equity_action.currency_code.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the equity action amounts are denominated.

lpp.equity_action.dividend_per_share.name: dividend_per_share
lpp.equity_action.dividend_per_share.description: Dividend amount distributed per individual share for dividend-type equity actions.

lpp.equity_action.program_name.name: program_name
lpp.equity_action.program_name.description: Name of the specific corporate program under which the equity action was conducted, such as a named buyback or dividend program.

lpp.equity_action.authorization_remainin.name: authorization_remaining
lpp.equity_action.authorization_remainin.description: Remaining monetary amount still authorized but not yet utilized under the equity action program at the time of the action.

lpp.fee_rate_card.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.fee_rate_card.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each fee rate card record.

lpp.fee_rate_card.bank_ref.name: bank_ref
lpp.fee_rate_card.bank_ref.description: Internal code identifying the bank or financial institution to which the fee rate card applies, e.g. BANK_ANZ, BANK_JPM.

lpp.fee_rate_card.service_code.name: service_code
lpp.fee_rate_card.service_code.description: Code identifying the specific banking or financial service type for which the fee rate is defined, e.g. 100, 250, AAA.

lpp.fee_rate_card.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.fee_rate_card.company_ref.description: Reference code identifying the company or legal entity associated with this fee rate card.

lpp.fee_rate_card.negotiated_rate.name: negotiated_rate
lpp.fee_rate_card.negotiated_rate.description: The bilaterally agreed fee rate charged for the service, expressed in the units defined by the rate_unit column.

lpp.fee_rate_card.rate_unit.name: rate_unit
lpp.fee_rate_card.rate_unit.description: The billing unit that defines how the negotiated rate is applied, e.g. per transaction, per month, or per USD 1,000.

lpp.fee_rate_card.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.fee_rate_card.currency_code.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the negotiated rate is denominated, e.g. USD.

lpp.fee_rate_card.effective_from.name: effective_from
lpp.fee_rate_card.effective_from.description: The calendar date from which the fee rate card becomes active and applicable.

lpp.fee_rate_card.effective_to.name: effective_to
lpp.fee_rate_card.effective_to.description: The calendar date on which the fee rate card expires and is no longer applicable; null indicates the rate is currently active with no set end date.

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier that uniquely identifies each forecast cash flow row.

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.snapshot_id.name: snapshot_id
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.snapshot_id.description: Coded identifier for a specific forecast run, encoding the snapshot date and frequency (e.g. FC_20240801_M = monthly forecast run from August 2024, FC_20241001_Q = quarterly forecast run from October 2024).

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.company_ref.description: Internal code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary within the group for which the cash flow is forecast (e.g. GR_US_INC, GR_GB, GR_TREASURY).

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.account_ref.name: account_ref
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.account_ref.description: Reference code identifying the bank or general ledger account associated with the forecast cash flow.

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.forecast_date.name: forecast_date
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.forecast_date.description: Calendar month start date to which the forecast cash flow applies, representing the period in which the cash movement is expected to occur.

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.flow_category.name: flow_category
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.flow_category.description: High-level business category classifying the type of cash flow, such as accounts receivable collections, accounts payable disbursements, payroll, tax, capital expenditure, debt service, or intercompany transfers.

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.flow_subcategory.name: flow_subcategory
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.flow_subcategory.description: More granular classification of the cash flow type, providing a breakdown within the high-level flow category.

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.direction.name: direction
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.direction.description: Indicates whether the forecast cash flow is an inflow (IN), outflow (OUT), or can be either direction (BOTH).

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.forecast_amount.name: forecast_amount
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.forecast_amount.description: Projected monetary value of the cash flow for the forecast period, expressed in the associated currency.

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.currency_code.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code indicating the currency in which the forecast amount is denominated (e.g. USD, GBP, JPY).

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.confidence.name: confidence
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.confidence.description: Analyst-assigned confidence level indicating how reliable or certain the forecast cash flow estimate is, ranging from HIGH to LOW.

lpp.forecast_cash_flow.seasonality_facto.name: seasonality_factor
lpp.forecast_cash_flow.seasonality_facto.description: Multiplicative adjustment factor applied to account for seasonal patterns in cash flows, where 1.0 represents no seasonal adjustment, values below 1.0 indicate a seasonal trough, and values above 1.0 indicate a seasonal peak.

lpp.forecast_snapshot.snapshot_id.name: snapshot_id
lpp.forecast_snapshot.snapshot_id.description: Unique coded identifier for a forecast snapshot run, encoding the forecast date and cadence (e.g. monthly 'M' or quarterly 'Q') in the format FC_YYYYMMDD_[cadence].

lpp.forecast_snapshot.snapshot_date.name: snapshot_date
lpp.forecast_snapshot.snapshot_date.description: Calendar date on which the forecast snapshot was taken or published.

lpp.forecast_snapshot.horizon_start_date.name: horizon_start_date
lpp.forecast_snapshot.horizon_start_date.description: First date of the forecast horizon window covered by this snapshot.

lpp.forecast_snapshot.horizon_end_date.name: horizon_end_date
lpp.forecast_snapshot.horizon_end_date.description: Last date of the forecast horizon window covered by this snapshot.

lpp.forecast_snapshot.granularity.name: granularity
lpp.forecast_snapshot.granularity.description: Time granularity at which forecast data points are generated, either daily or monthly.

lpp.forecast_snapshot.model_version.name: model_version
lpp.forecast_snapshot.model_version.description: Version identifier of the forecasting model used to generate this snapshot (e.g. 'v1.3').

lpp.forecast_snapshot.description.name: description
lpp.forecast_snapshot.description.description: Human-readable label describing the forecast type, cadence, and methodology of the snapshot (e.g. 'Monthly 13-week direct forecast').

lpp.forecast_vs_actual.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.forecast_vs_actual.company_ref.description: Internal code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary within the group (e.g. GR_AE, GR_DE, GR_US_INC).

lpp.forecast_vs_actual.period_date.name: period_date
lpp.forecast_vs_actual.period_date.description: Month-end date representing the financial reporting period to which forecast and actual amounts relate.

lpp.forecast_vs_actual.flow_category.name: flow_category
lpp.forecast_vs_actual.flow_category.description: Classification of the cash flow type driving the forecast or actual entry (e.g. payroll, tax, accounts payable disbursement).

lpp.forecast_vs_actual.forecast_amount.name: forecast_amount
lpp.forecast_vs_actual.forecast_amount.description: Planned or budgeted cash flow amount for the legal entity, period, and flow category in the reporting currency.

lpp.forecast_vs_actual.actual_amount.name: actual_amount
lpp.forecast_vs_actual.actual_amount.description: Realised cash flow amount recorded for the legal entity, period, and flow category in the reporting currency.

lpp.forecast_vs_actual.variance_amount.name: variance_amount
lpp.forecast_vs_actual.variance_amount.description: Absolute difference between actual and forecast cash flow amounts, indicating over- or under-performance against plan.

lpp.forecast_vs_actual.variance_pct.name: variance_pct
lpp.forecast_vs_actual.variance_pct.description: Percentage variance of actual versus forecast cash flow, expressed as a whole-number percentage (e.g. -7.0000 = -7%).

lpp.forecast_vs_actual.snapshot_id.name: snapshot_id
lpp.forecast_vs_actual.snapshot_id.description: Unique identifier for the forecast snapshot, encoding the forecast run date and frequency (e.g. FC_20230501_M = monthly forecast run on 2023-05-01).

lpp.forecast_vs_actual.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.forecast_vs_actual.currency_code.description: ISO 4-letter currency code in which all monetary amounts in this table are denominated (currently USD only).

lpp.fraud_detection_event.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.fraud_detection_event.uuid.description: Unique identifier for each fraud detection event record.

lpp.fraud_detection_event.transfer_uuid.name: transfer_uuid
lpp.fraud_detection_event.transfer_uuid.description: Unique identifier of the payment transfer associated with this fraud detection event.

lpp.fraud_detection_event.file_uuid.name: file_uuid
lpp.fraud_detection_event.file_uuid.description: Unique identifier of the file associated with this fraud detection event.

lpp.fraud_detection_event.decision.name: decision
lpp.fraud_detection_event.decision.description: Outcome of the fraud evaluation — whether the transaction was allowed, flagged for manual review, or blocked.
value_aliases: BLOCK -> Blocked / Rejected due to fraud risk

lpp.fraud_detection_event.score.name: score
lpp.fraud_detection_event.score.description: Numerical fraud risk score assigned to the event, where higher values typically indicate greater fraud risk.

lpp.fraud_detection_event.reason_codes.name: reason_codes
lpp.fraud_detection_event.reason_codes.description: Structured list of codes explaining the factors that contributed to the fraud decision.

lpp.fraud_detection_event.raised_at.name: raised_at
lpp.fraud_detection_event.raised_at.description: Timestamp at which the fraud detection event was generated.

lpp.fraud_loss.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.fraud_loss.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each fraud loss record.

lpp.fraud_loss.detection_event_uuid.name: detection_event_uuid
lpp.fraud_loss.detection_event_uuid.description: Unique identifier referencing the fraud detection event that triggered this loss record.

lpp.fraud_loss.authorization_ref.name: authorization_ref
lpp.fraud_loss.authorization_ref.description: UUID-format reference code identifying the payment authorization associated with the fraud loss.

lpp.fraud_loss.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.fraud_loss.company_ref.description: Internal code identifying the legal entity or regional subsidiary where the fraud loss occurred (e.g., GR_US_INC, GR_GB).

lpp.fraud_loss.channel.name: channel
lpp.fraud_loss.channel.description: Sales or service channel through which the fraudulent transaction was made (e.g., IN_WAREHOUSE, ECOMMERCE, MEMBERSHIP_RENEWAL).

lpp.fraud_loss.loss_date.name: loss_date
lpp.fraud_loss.loss_date.description: Calendar date on which the fraud loss was recorded or incurred.

lpp.fraud_loss.loss_amount.name: loss_amount
lpp.fraud_loss.loss_amount.description: Monetary value of the fraud loss incurred on the transaction, denominated in the associated currency.

lpp.fraud_loss.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.fraud_loss.currency_code.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the currency in which the loss amount is expressed (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

lpp.fraud_loss.loss_category.name: loss_category
lpp.fraud_loss.loss_category.description: Classification of the fraud loss type, distinguishing between friendly fraud (customer dispute) and true fraud (unauthorized third-party).
value_aliases: TRUE_FRAUD -> true fraud / third-party unauthorized fraud

lpp.fraud_loss.fraud_vector.name: fraud_vector
lpp.fraud_loss.fraud_vector.description: Attack method or mechanism used to perpetrate the fraud (e.g., SOCIAL_ENGINEERING, CARD_NOT_PRESENT).

lpp.fraud_loss.issuer_country.name: issuer_country
lpp.fraud_loss.issuer_country.description: ISO 2-letter country code of the card-issuing bank associated with the fraudulent transaction.

lpp.fraud_loss.auth_method.name: auth_method
lpp.fraud_loss.auth_method.description: Authentication method used at the time of the transaction, indicating whether 3D Secure was applied and how (e.g., 3DS_CHALLENGED, 3DS_FRICTIONLESS, NO_3DS, NONE).

lpp.fraud_loss.recovered_amount.name: recovered_amount
lpp.fraud_loss.recovered_amount.description: Monetary amount recovered after the fraud loss was identified, reducing the net exposure.

lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each FX exposure forecast record.

lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.company_ref.description: Internal code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary carrying the FX exposure (e.g. GR_EU_BV, GR_US_INC).

lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.forecast_period.name: forecast_period
lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.forecast_period.description: Month-end date representing the future period for which the FX exposure is being forecast.

lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.tenor_bucket.name: tenor_bucket
lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.tenor_bucket.description: Time-to-maturity band classifying the forecast exposure into short-dated ranges (0–1 month, 1–3 months, or 3–6 months).

lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.exposure_curren.name: exposure_currency
lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.exposure_curren.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the foreign currency in which the exposure is denominated (e.g. USD, EUR, MXN).

lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.functional_curr.name: functional_currency
lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.functional_curr.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the reporting entity's functional (base) currency used to measure the exposure.

lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.gross_exposure_.name: gross_exposure_amount
lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.gross_exposure_.description: Total gross monetary value of the FX exposure for the forecast period, expressed in the exposure currency before any netting or hedging.

lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.direction.name: direction
lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.direction.description: Indicates whether the exposure is a long (receivable/asset) or short (payable/liability) FX position.
value_aliases: LONG -> Long / FX receivable or asset position
SHORT -> Short / FX payable or liability position

lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.source.name: source
lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.source.description: Business origination category of the FX exposure, indicating whether it arises from accounts payable, accounts receivable, intercompany loans, or forecasted purchases or sales.

lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.snapshot_date.name: snapshot_date
lpp.fx_exposure_forecast.snapshot_date.description: Month-end date on which the forecast data was captured, representing the as-of date of the exposure snapshot.

lpp.fx_forward.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.fx_forward.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each FX forward record.

lpp.fx_forward.deal_id.name: deal_id
lpp.fx_forward.deal_id.description: Human-readable business reference code for an FX forward deal, formatted as FXF-XXXXXXX.

lpp.fx_forward.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.fx_forward.company_ref.description: Internal code identifying the legal entity within the group that is a party to the FX forward (e.g. GR_US_INC, GR_EU_BV).

lpp.fx_forward.counterparty_bank_ref.name: counterparty_bank_ref
lpp.fx_forward.counterparty_bank_ref.description: Internal code identifying the external bank acting as counterparty on the FX forward trade (e.g. BANK_HSBC, BANK_JPM).

lpp.fx_forward.trade_date.name: trade_date
lpp.fx_forward.trade_date.description: Calendar date on which the FX forward contract was executed and agreed between the parties.

lpp.fx_forward.value_date.name: value_date
lpp.fx_forward.value_date.description: Calendar date on which the FX forward contract matures and the currency exchange is physically settled.

lpp.fx_forward.buy_currency.name: buy_currency
lpp.fx_forward.buy_currency.description: ISO 4217 3-letter currency code of the currency being purchased under the FX forward contract.

lpp.fx_forward.buy_amount.name: buy_amount
lpp.fx_forward.buy_amount.description: Notional amount of the currency being purchased, expressed in the buy currency.

lpp.fx_forward.sell_currency.name: sell_currency
lpp.fx_forward.sell_currency.description: ISO 4217 3-letter currency code of the currency being sold under the FX forward contract (USD in all observed records).

lpp.fx_forward.sell_amount.name: sell_amount
lpp.fx_forward.sell_amount.description: Notional amount of the currency being sold, expressed in the sell currency.

lpp.fx_forward.forward_rate.name: forward_rate
lpp.fx_forward.forward_rate.description: Contracted exchange rate at which the buy and sell currencies will be exchanged on the value date.

lpp.fx_forward.spot_at_trade.name: spot_at_trade
lpp.fx_forward.spot_at_trade.description: Prevailing spot exchange rate between the buy and sell currencies at the time the forward contract was executed.

lpp.fx_forward.status.name: status
lpp.fx_forward.status.description: Current lifecycle status of the FX forward contract, indicating whether it is open, settled, or cancelled.

lpp.fx_rate.rate_date.name: rate_date
lpp.fx_rate.rate_date.description: Calendar date on which the foreign exchange rate is effective.

lpp.fx_rate.base_currency.name: base_currency
lpp.fx_rate.base_currency.description: ISO 4217 three-letter code for the currency being priced (the denominator currency in the exchange rate pair).

lpp.fx_rate.quote_currency.name: quote_currency
lpp.fx_rate.quote_currency.description: ISO 4217 three-letter code for the currency in which the base currency is quoted (the numerator currency in the exchange rate pair).

lpp.fx_rate.rate.name: rate
lpp.fx_rate.rate.description: Numeric exchange rate expressing how many units of the quote currency equal one unit of the base currency on the given date.

lpp.fx_rate.rate_type.name: rate_type
lpp.fx_rate.rate_type.description: Classification of how the exchange rate was determined, such as a real-time spot rate, end-of-day closing rate, or period average rate.

lpp.fx_rate.source.name: source
lpp.fx_rate.source.description: Provider or origin system from which the exchange rate was sourced, such as Bloomberg, the European Central Bank, or an internal system.

lpp.fx_rate.as_of_timestamp.name: as_of_timestamp
lpp.fx_rate.as_of_timestamp.description: Exact date and time (with timezone) at which the exchange rate record was last loaded or refreshed into the system.

lpp.gen_company_region.company_code.name: company_code
lpp.gen_company_region.company_code.description: Internal alphanumeric code identifying a legal entity within the group (e.g. GR_DE, GR_AU, GR_APAC_PTE).

lpp.gen_company_region.region.name: region
lpp.gen_company_region.region.description: Geographic business region to which a company entity belongs, using standard multi-country groupings (e.g. EMEA, APAC, LATAM, AMER, MENA).

lpp.gen_company_region.functional_ccy.name: functional_ccy
lpp.gen_company_region.functional_ccy.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code representing the functional (local reporting) currency of the company entity (e.g. EUR, GBP, AUD).

lpp.gl_account.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.gl_account.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each general ledger account record.

lpp.gl_account.code.name: code
lpp.gl_account.code.description: Structured alphanumeric code identifying a GL account, encoding the numeric account number, company reference, and account purpose (e.g. '1110-GR_AE_COLLECTION_1').

lpp.gl_account.description.name: description
lpp.gl_account.description.description: Human-readable label describing the purpose and classification of the GL account (e.g. 'Cash - GR_AU PAYROLL Account', 'Accounts Receivable', 'Revenue').

lpp.gl_account.chart_of_accounts.name: chart_of_accounts
lpp.gl_account.chart_of_accounts.description: The ERP system or accounting framework under which the GL account is defined (e.g. SAP, NETSUITE, ORACLE).

lpp.gl_account.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.gl_account.company_ref.description: Internal company or legal entity code to which the GL account belongs (e.g. 'GR_AE' for the UAE entity, 'GR_AU' for Australia).

lpp.gl_account.bank_account_ref.name: bank_account_ref
lpp.gl_account.bank_account_ref.description: Internal reference code identifying the specific bank account linked to this GL account, where applicable (e.g. 'GR_AE_COLLECTION_1'); null for non-cash accounts.

lpp.gl_account.account_class.name: account_class
lpp.gl_account.account_class.description: High-level balance sheet or income statement classification of the GL account (e.g. ASSET, LIABILITY, REVENUE, EXPENSE, EQUITY).

lpp.gl_account.currency_ref.name: currency_ref
lpp.gl_account.currency_ref.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code representing the functional currency of the GL account (e.g. 'AED', 'EUR', 'USD').

lpp.gl_balance.gl_account_ref.name: gl_account_ref
lpp.gl_balance.gl_account_ref.description: Composite reference code uniquely identifying a general ledger account, combining a numeric account code with an entity/region segment (e.g. '2200-GR_KR', '1110-IHB_CHF_INVESTMENT').

lpp.gl_balance.balance_date.name: balance_date
lpp.gl_balance.balance_date.description: Month-end date as of which the general ledger balance is recorded, always falling on the last calendar day of a month.

lpp.gl_balance.balance_type.name: balance_type
lpp.gl_balance.balance_type.description: Classification of the balance snapshot, indicating whether it represents a closing (period-end) balance.

lpp.gl_balance.amount.name: amount
lpp.gl_balance.amount.description: Monetary balance amount recorded against the general ledger account for the given period, expressed in the account's currency.

lpp.gl_balance.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.gl_balance.currency_code.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code denoting the currency in which the balance amount is denominated (e.g. 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP').

lpp.gl_balance.source_system.name: source_system
lpp.gl_balance.source_system.description: Name of the upstream ERP or financial system from which the general ledger balance data was extracted (e.g. 'SAP', 'ORACLE', 'NETSUITE').

lpp.gl_balance.loaded_at.name: loaded_at
lpp.gl_balance.loaded_at.description: UTC timestamp recording when the balance record was loaded into the data warehouse, aligned to month-end boundaries.

lpp.gl_reconciliation.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.gl_reconciliation.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier for each GL reconciliation record.

lpp.gl_reconciliation.bank_account_ref.name: bank_account_ref
lpp.gl_reconciliation.bank_account_ref.description: Internal reference code identifying the specific bank account being reconciled, encoding region, currency, and account purpose (e.g. operating, payroll, collection).

lpp.gl_reconciliation.gl_account_ref.name: gl_account_ref
lpp.gl_reconciliation.gl_account_ref.description: Internal reference code identifying the general ledger account corresponding to a bank account, combining a GL account number prefix with the bank account reference (e.g. '1110-GR_DE_OPERATING_1').

lpp.gl_reconciliation.as_of_date.name: as_of_date
lpp.gl_reconciliation.as_of_date.description: Month-end date as of which the bank-to-GL reconciliation was performed.

lpp.gl_reconciliation.bank_balance.name: bank_balance
lpp.gl_reconciliation.bank_balance.description: Closing balance as reported by the bank for the account at the reconciliation date.

lpp.gl_reconciliation.gl_balance.name: gl_balance
lpp.gl_reconciliation.gl_balance.description: Closing balance recorded in the general ledger for the account at the reconciliation date.

lpp.gl_reconciliation.variance_amount.name: variance_amount
lpp.gl_reconciliation.variance_amount.description: Numeric difference between the bank balance and the GL balance at the reconciliation date; zero indicates a fully matched reconciliation.

lpp.gl_reconciliation.variance_currency.name: variance_currency
lpp.gl_reconciliation.variance_currency.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the variance amount is denominated.

lpp.gl_reconciliation.status.name: status
lpp.gl_reconciliation.status.description: Reconciliation status indicating whether the bank and GL balances have been matched or are still under investigation.
value_aliases: MATCHED -> bank and GL balances fully reconciled
INVESTIGATING -> variance identified and under active investigation

lpp.gl_reconciliation.notes.name: notes
lpp.gl_reconciliation.notes.description: Free-text commentary entered by reconciliation staff describing the nature of a variance, its root cause, or resolution details.

lpp.hedge_dedesignation.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.hedge_dedesignation.uuid.description: System-generated unique identifier for each hedge de-designation record.

lpp.hedge_dedesignation.hedge_ref.name: hedge_ref
lpp.hedge_dedesignation.hedge_ref.description: Business reference code identifying the hedging relationship being de-designated (e.g., HR-0001216).

lpp.hedge_dedesignation.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.hedge_dedesignation.company_ref.description: Internal code identifying the legal entity or company associated with the hedge de-designation (e.g., GR_EU_BV, GR_TREASURY).

lpp.hedge_dedesignation.currency_ref.name: currency_ref
lpp.hedge_dedesignation.currency_ref.description: ISO 3-letter currency code representing the currency of the hedge being de-designated (e.g., BRL, SGD, AUD).

lpp.hedge_dedesignation.dedesignation_da.name: dedesignation_date
lpp.hedge_dedesignation.dedesignation_da.description: Calendar date on which the hedge relationship was formally de-designated.

lpp.hedge_dedesignation.amount.name: amount
lpp.hedge_dedesignation.amount.description: Monetary amount associated with the hedge de-designation event.

lpp.hedge_dedesignation.reason.name: reason
lpp.hedge_dedesignation.reason.description: Business reason explaining why the hedge relationship was de-designated (e.g., Restructuring, Underlying instrument terminated).
value_aliases: Restructuring -> Hedge removed due to organisational or financial restructuring
Underlying instrument terminated -> Hedge removed because the hedged item or instrument was terminated

lpp.hedge_relationship.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.hedge_relationship.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each hedge relationship record.

lpp.hedge_relationship.code.name: code
lpp.hedge_relationship.code.description: Human-readable business reference code uniquely identifying a hedge relationship, formatted as HR-XXXXXXX.

lpp.hedge_relationship.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.hedge_relationship.company_ref.description: Internal code identifying the legal entity or subsidiary that owns the hedge relationship.

lpp.hedge_relationship.hedge_type.name: hedge_type
lpp.hedge_relationship.hedge_type.description: IFRS/ASC 815 hedge accounting classification indicating whether the relationship is a fair value hedge, cash flow hedge, or net investment hedge.

lpp.hedge_relationship.hedged_item_type.name: hedged_item_type
lpp.hedge_relationship.hedged_item_type.description: Category of the underlying exposure being hedged, such as a forecasted purchase/sale or a recognised receivable/payable.
value_aliases: NET_INVESTMENT -> Net Investment in Foreign Operation

lpp.hedge_relationship.hedged_currency.name: hedged_currency
lpp.hedge_relationship.hedged_currency.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the foreign currency exposure being hedged.

lpp.hedge_relationship.designation_date.name: designation_date
lpp.hedge_relationship.designation_date.description: Calendar date on which the hedge relationship was formally designated for hedge accounting.

lpp.hedge_relationship.dedesignation_dat.name: dedesignation_date
lpp.hedge_relationship.dedesignation_dat.description: Calendar date on which the hedge relationship was voluntarily or involuntarily de-designated, ceasing hedge accounting treatment; null for relationships still active.

lpp.hedge_relationship.instrument_type.name: instrument_type
lpp.hedge_relationship.instrument_type.description: Type of financial derivative instrument used as the hedging instrument, currently limited to FX forward contracts.

lpp.hedge_relationship.instrument_ref.name: instrument_ref
lpp.hedge_relationship.instrument_ref.description: Business reference code identifying the specific hedging instrument (FX forward) associated with the hedge relationship, formatted as FXF-XXXXXXX.

lpp.hedge_relationship.notional_amount.name: notional_amount
lpp.hedge_relationship.notional_amount.description: Face value or contract size of the hedging instrument expressed in the notional currency.

lpp.hedge_relationship.notional_currency.name: notional_currency
lpp.hedge_relationship.notional_currency.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the notional amount of the hedging instrument is denominated.

lpp.hedge_relationship.effectiveness_met.name: effectiveness_method
lpp.hedge_relationship.effectiveness_met.description: Methodology used to assess and measure hedge effectiveness, currently dollar-offset across all relationships.

lpp.hedge_relationship.status.name: status
lpp.hedge_relationship.status.description: Current lifecycle status of the hedge relationship, indicating whether it is active, voluntarily terminated, or de-designated.

lpp.intercompany_transaction.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.intercompany_transaction.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier (UUID) that serves as the primary key for each intercompany transaction record.

lpp.intercompany_transaction.reference.name: reference
lpp.intercompany_transaction.reference.description: Human-readable intercompany transaction reference number in the format IC-XXXXXXX, used to identify and track a transaction across systems.

lpp.intercompany_transaction.transaction.name: transaction_date
lpp.intercompany_transaction.transaction.description: Calendar date on which the intercompany transaction was recorded or initiated.

lpp.intercompany_transaction.value_date.name: value_date
lpp.intercompany_transaction.value_date.description: Calendar date on which the funds are actually made available or the financial effect of the transaction takes place.

lpp.intercompany_transaction.amount.name: amount
lpp.intercompany_transaction.amount.description: Monetary value of the intercompany transaction in the transaction currency.

lpp.intercompany_transaction.currency_co.name: currency_code
lpp.intercompany_transaction.currency_co.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code denoting the currency in which the transaction amount is denominated (e.g., EUR, USD, GBP).

lpp.intercompany_transaction.purpose.name: purpose
lpp.intercompany_transaction.purpose.description: Business purpose or category of the intercompany transaction, such as funding, loan, service fee, dividend, royalty, or cash pool movement.

lpp.intercompany_transaction.source_comp.name: source_company_ref
lpp.intercompany_transaction.source_comp.description: Internal reference code identifying the group entity that is the originating (sending) party of the intercompany transaction.

lpp.intercompany_transaction.source_acco.name: source_account_ref
lpp.intercompany_transaction.source_acco.description: Internal reference code identifying the in-house bank concentration account of the source entity from which funds are debited for the transaction.

lpp.intercompany_transaction.source_cash.name: source_cash_flow_ref
lpp.intercompany_transaction.source_cash.description: UUID reference linking this intercompany transaction to the corresponding cash flow record on the source (sending) side.

lpp.intercompany_transaction.target_comp.name: target_company_ref
lpp.intercompany_transaction.target_comp.description: Internal reference code identifying the group entity that is the receiving (destination) party of the intercompany transaction (e.g., GR_MX, GR_GB, GR_DE).

lpp.intercompany_transaction.target_acco.name: target_account_ref
lpp.intercompany_transaction.target_acco.description: Internal reference code identifying the collection account of the target entity into which funds are credited for the transaction.

lpp.intercompany_transaction.target_cash.name: target_cash_flow_ref
lpp.intercompany_transaction.target_cash.description: UUID reference linking this intercompany transaction to the corresponding cash flow record on the target (receiving) side.

lpp.intercompany_transaction.status.name: status
lpp.intercompany_transaction.status.description: Current processing status of the intercompany transaction, indicating whether it has been completed (SETTLED) or is still in progress (INITIATED).

lpp.interest_accrual.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.interest_accrual.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each interest accrual record.

lpp.interest_accrual.accrual_date.name: accrual_date
lpp.interest_accrual.accrual_date.description: Calendar date on which the interest was accrued.

lpp.interest_accrual.source_type.name: source_type
lpp.interest_accrual.source_type.description: Category of the financial instrument or obligation that generated the interest accrual, such as a borrowing, investment position, or credit facility fee.

lpp.interest_accrual.source_uuid.name: source_uuid
lpp.interest_accrual.source_uuid.description: Unique identifier of the specific financial instrument or obligation (e.g. a borrowing or investment position) that generated this interest accrual.

lpp.interest_accrual.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.interest_accrual.company_ref.description: Internal company or legal entity code identifying which group entity the interest accrual belongs to (e.g. GR_GB for the UK entity, GR_JP for the Japan entity).

lpp.interest_accrual.amount.name: amount
lpp.interest_accrual.amount.description: Monetary value of the interest accrued for the given date and source, expressed in the associated currency.

lpp.interest_accrual.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.interest_accrual.currency_code.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the accrual amount is denominated (e.g. USD, GBP, JPY).

lpp.interest_accrual.direction.name: direction
lpp.interest_accrual.direction.description: Indicates whether the accrued interest represents a cost to the entity (EXPENSE) or a receipt of income (INCOME).

lpp.investment_instrument.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.investment_instrument.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier that serves as the primary key for each investment instrument record.

lpp.investment_instrument.code.name: code
lpp.investment_instrument.code.description: Human-readable alphanumeric business code uniquely identifying each investment instrument (e.g. INV_MMF_0014).

lpp.investment_instrument.instrument_typ.name: instrument_type
lpp.investment_instrument.instrument_typ.description: Category of investment instrument, such as money market fund, time deposit, treasury, certificate of deposit, commercial paper, repo, or bond.

lpp.investment_instrument.issuer_name.name: issuer_name
lpp.investment_instrument.issuer_name.description: Full display name of the entity that issued the investment instrument (e.g. BlackRock MMF, US Treasury, Bundesrepublik Deutschland).

lpp.investment_instrument.issuer_bank_re.name: issuer_bank_ref
lpp.investment_instrument.issuer_bank_re.description: Internal reference code identifying the bank that issued the instrument, applicable when the issuer is a bank (e.g. BANK_HSBC, BANK_JPM).

lpp.investment_instrument.currency_ref.name: currency_ref
lpp.investment_instrument.currency_ref.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the investment instrument is denominated (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, SGD).

lpp.investment_instrument.coupon_rate.name: coupon_rate
lpp.investment_instrument.coupon_rate.description: Annual coupon interest rate (in percentage points) paid by the instrument to its holder (e.g. 4.10, 5.10).

lpp.investment_instrument.issue_date.name: issue_date
lpp.investment_instrument.issue_date.description: Calendar date on which the investment instrument was originally issued.

lpp.investment_instrument.maturity_date.name: maturity_date
lpp.investment_instrument.maturity_date.description: Calendar date on which the investment instrument reaches maturity and the principal is due to be repaid.

lpp.investment_instrument.rating.name: rating
lpp.investment_instrument.rating.description: Credit rating assigned to the investment instrument by a rating agency, indicating its creditworthiness (e.g. AAA, AA+, A-1).

lpp.investment_position.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.investment_position.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each investment position record.

lpp.investment_position.instrument_ref.name: instrument_ref
lpp.investment_position.instrument_ref.description: Internal reference code identifying the specific financial instrument (e.g. money market fund) held in the position.

lpp.investment_position.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.investment_position.company_ref.description: Internal code identifying the company or business entity (e.g. group treasury) that owns the investment position.

lpp.investment_position.bank_account_ref.name: bank_account_ref
lpp.investment_position.bank_account_ref.description: Internal reference code identifying the investment bank account, including the currency denomination (e.g. IHB_USD_INVESTMENT, IHB_EUR_INVESTMENT).

lpp.investment_position.as_of_date.name: as_of_date
lpp.investment_position.as_of_date.description: The reporting date as of which the investment position snapshot was recorded.

lpp.investment_position.face_amount.name: face_amount
lpp.investment_position.face_amount.description: The nominal or par value of the investment instrument held in the position.

lpp.investment_position.market_value.name: market_value
lpp.investment_position.market_value.description: The current market value of the investment position, reflecting prevailing prices at the reporting date.

lpp.investment_position.book_value.name: book_value
lpp.investment_position.book_value.description: The carrying or book value of the investment position as recorded in the general ledger.

lpp.investment_position.accrued_interest.name: accrued_interest
lpp.investment_position.accrued_interest.description: The amount of interest that has accumulated on the investment position since the last coupon or interest payment date.

lpp.investment_position.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.investment_position.currency_code.description: ISO 3-letter currency code denoting the denomination of the investment position (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, SGD).

lpp.investment_position.yield_to_maturit.name: yield_to_maturity
lpp.investment_position.yield_to_maturit.description: The annualised yield to maturity of the investment instrument, expressed as a percentage (e.g. 5.20 = 5.20%).

lpp.investment_position.duration_days.name: duration_days
lpp.investment_position.duration_days.description: The remaining duration of the investment instrument expressed in calendar days until maturity.

lpp.investment_transaction.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.investment_transaction.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each investment transaction record.

lpp.investment_transaction.instrument_re.name: instrument_ref
lpp.investment_transaction.instrument_re.description: Internal reference code identifying the specific investment instrument involved in the transaction (e.g. term deposits, bonds, repos, money market funds).

lpp.investment_transaction.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.investment_transaction.company_ref.description: Internal reference code identifying the company or treasury entity that owns or initiated the investment transaction.

lpp.investment_transaction.bank_account_.name: bank_account_ref
lpp.investment_transaction.bank_account_.description: Internal reference code identifying the bank account used to fund or receive proceeds of the investment transaction, segmented by currency.

lpp.investment_transaction.transaction_t.name: transaction_type
lpp.investment_transaction.transaction_t.description: Category of investment transaction, indicating whether it represents an initial purchase, a coupon/interest payment, or the return of principal at maturity.

lpp.investment_transaction.trade_date.name: trade_date
lpp.investment_transaction.trade_date.description: Calendar date on which the investment transaction was agreed or executed in the market.

lpp.investment_transaction.settle_date.name: settle_date
lpp.investment_transaction.settle_date.description: Calendar date on which cash and securities are exchanged and the investment transaction is financially settled.

lpp.investment_transaction.amount.name: amount
lpp.investment_transaction.amount.description: Monetary value of the investment transaction, representing the cash flow (principal invested, coupon received, or principal returned) in the transaction currency.

lpp.investment_transaction.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.investment_transaction.currency_code.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code denoting the currency in which the investment transaction is denominated.

lpp.investment_transaction.price.name: price
lpp.investment_transaction.price.description: Clean price of the investment instrument at the time of the transaction, expressed as a decimal fraction of par (e.g. 0.9905 = 99.05% of face value).

lpp.investment_transaction.yield_at_trad.name: yield_at_trade
lpp.investment_transaction.yield_at_trad.description: Annualised yield (in percentage terms) of the investment instrument locked in at the time of the trade, e.g. 5.05 represents a 5.05% yield.

lpp.kg_relationship.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.kg_relationship.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier for each knowledge graph relationship record.

lpp.kg_relationship.relationship_type.name: relationship_type
lpp.kg_relationship.relationship_type.description: The category or nature of the directed relationship between two knowledge graph entities (e.g. 'owns', 'employs', 'is_part_of').

lpp.kg_relationship.from_entity_type.name: from_entity_type
lpp.kg_relationship.from_entity_type.description: The classification or category of the source entity in the directed relationship (e.g. 'person', 'organisation', 'product').

lpp.kg_relationship.from_entity_code.name: from_entity_code
lpp.kg_relationship.from_entity_code.description: The unique business code or identifier representing the specific source entity in the directed relationship.

lpp.kg_relationship.to_entity_type.name: to_entity_type
lpp.kg_relationship.to_entity_type.description: The classification or category of the target entity in the directed relationship (e.g. 'person', 'organisation', 'product').

lpp.kg_relationship.to_entity_code.name: to_entity_code
lpp.kg_relationship.to_entity_code.description: The unique business code or identifier representing the specific target entity in the directed relationship.

lpp.kg_relationship.properties.name: properties
lpp.kg_relationship.properties.description: Semi-structured document storing additional attributes and metadata about the relationship as key-value pairs.

lpp.kg_relationship.captured_by_user.name: captured_by_user
lpp.kg_relationship.captured_by_user.description: The username or identifier of the user who recorded or asserted this relationship into the knowledge graph.

lpp.kg_relationship.captured_at.name: captured_at
lpp.kg_relationship.captured_at.description: The exact date and time (with timezone) at which this relationship was recorded in the knowledge graph.

lpp.kg_relationship.source_session.name: source_session
lpp.kg_relationship.source_session.description: The identifier of the ingestion or user session during which this relationship was captured.

lpp.kg_relationship.confidence.name: confidence
lpp.kg_relationship.confidence.description: A rating or score indicating the degree of certainty or trust assigned to the asserted relationship.

lpp.kg_relationship.status.name: status
lpp.kg_relationship.status.description: The current lifecycle or validation state of the relationship record within the knowledge graph.

lpp.letter_of_credit.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.letter_of_credit.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier that serves as the primary key for each letter of credit record.

lpp.letter_of_credit.lc_number.name: lc_number
lpp.letter_of_credit.lc_number.description: Human-readable reference number assigned to each letter of credit, following the format LC-{YEAR}-{SEQUENCE} (e.g., LC-2024-00021).

lpp.letter_of_credit.issuing_bank_ref.name: issuing_bank_ref
lpp.letter_of_credit.issuing_bank_ref.description: Internal code identifying the bank that issued the letter of credit (e.g., BANK_HSBC, BANK_JPM).

lpp.letter_of_credit.applicant_company_r.name: applicant_company_ref
lpp.letter_of_credit.applicant_company_r.description: Internal code identifying the company entity within the group that applied for the letter of credit (e.g., GR_US_INC, GR_GB).

lpp.letter_of_credit.beneficiary_name.name: beneficiary_name
lpp.letter_of_credit.beneficiary_name.description: Full name of the party entitled to draw on the letter of credit, such as a supplier, utility, tax authority, or insurance fund.

lpp.letter_of_credit.beneficiary_country.name: beneficiary_country
lpp.letter_of_credit.beneficiary_country.description: ISO 2-letter country code identifying the country where the beneficiary is located (e.g., US, GB, CN).

lpp.letter_of_credit.lc_type.name: lc_type
lpp.letter_of_credit.lc_type.description: Classification of the letter of credit as either a STANDBY (guarantee-like instrument) or COMMERCIAL (trade payment instrument).

lpp.letter_of_credit.purpose.name: purpose
lpp.letter_of_credit.purpose.description: Free-text description of the business reason the letter of credit was issued, such as utility deposit, apparel imports, or customs duty deferment.

lpp.letter_of_credit.issue_date.name: issue_date
lpp.letter_of_credit.issue_date.description: Calendar date on which the letter of credit was formally issued by the bank.

lpp.letter_of_credit.expiration_date.name: expiration_date
lpp.letter_of_credit.expiration_date.description: Calendar date on which the letter of credit expires and can no longer be drawn upon.

lpp.letter_of_credit.face_amount.name: face_amount
lpp.letter_of_credit.face_amount.description: Total maximum monetary value that can be drawn under the letter of credit, denominated in the instrument's currency.

lpp.letter_of_credit.drawn_amount.name: drawn_amount
lpp.letter_of_credit.drawn_amount.description: Cumulative monetary amount that has already been drawn or called against the letter of credit by the beneficiary.

lpp.letter_of_credit.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.letter_of_credit.currency_code.description: ISO 3-letter currency code in which the letter of credit is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

lpp.letter_of_credit.status.name: status
lpp.letter_of_credit.status.description: Current lifecycle status of the letter of credit, indicating whether it is active, has been drawn upon, or has expired.

lpp.letter_of_credit.credit_facility_ref.name: credit_facility_ref
lpp.letter_of_credit.credit_facility_ref.description: Internal code identifying the revolving credit facility under which this letter of credit was issued (e.g., CF_RCF_USD_2B, CF_RCF_EUR_500M).

lpp.letter_of_credit.fee_bps.name: fee_bps
lpp.letter_of_credit.fee_bps.description: Annual fee charged for the letter of credit, expressed in basis points (1 basis point = 0.01%).

lpp.liquidity_policy.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.liquidity_policy.uuid.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each liquidity policy record.

lpp.liquidity_policy.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.liquidity_policy.company_ref.description: Reference code identifying the specific legal entity or company to which the liquidity policy applies.

lpp.liquidity_policy.company_group_ref.name: company_group_ref
lpp.liquidity_policy.company_group_ref.description: Code identifying the regional or global group hierarchy to which the liquidity policy is scoped, such as global, Americas, EMEA, or APAC.

lpp.liquidity_policy.policy_type.name: policy_type
lpp.liquidity_policy.policy_type.description: Code classifying the type of liquidity constraint the policy enforces, such as a minimum liquidity level, minimum operating cash, maximum counterparty concentration percentage, or maximum instrument tenor.

lpp.liquidity_policy.threshold_amount.name: threshold_amount
lpp.liquidity_policy.threshold_amount.description: Absolute monetary threshold value that the liquidity policy enforces, denominated in the currency specified alongside it (null for percentage-based policies).

lpp.liquidity_policy.threshold_currency.name: threshold_currency
lpp.liquidity_policy.threshold_currency.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code indicating the currency in which the threshold amount is expressed.

lpp.liquidity_policy.threshold_pct.name: threshold_pct
lpp.liquidity_policy.threshold_pct.description: Percentage-based threshold value the liquidity policy enforces, used for policies such as maximum counterparty concentration (null for absolute monetary policies).

lpp.liquidity_policy.effective_from.name: effective_from
lpp.liquidity_policy.effective_from.description: Date on which the liquidity policy comes into effect and begins to be enforced.

lpp.liquidity_policy.effective_to.name: effective_to
lpp.liquidity_policy.effective_to.description: Date on which the liquidity policy expires or ceases to be enforced; null indicates the policy is currently open-ended and active.

lpp.liquidity_policy.description.name: description
lpp.liquidity_policy.description.description: Human-readable narrative label describing the purpose or scope of the liquidity policy rule, such as a minimum cash buffer level or counterparty concentration cap.

lpp.macro_indicator.indicator_code.name: indicator_code
lpp.macro_indicator.indicator_code.description: Short alphanumeric code identifying the macroeconomic indicator being tracked, such as Federal Funds Rate, SOFR 3-month, Geopolitical Risk Index, US CPI, EUR/USD volatility, or Brent crude oil price.

lpp.macro_indicator.region.name: region
lpp.macro_indicator.region.description: Geographic scope of the macroeconomic indicator, either limited to the United States (US) or applicable globally (GLOBAL).

lpp.macro_indicator.as_of_date.name: as_of_date
lpp.macro_indicator.as_of_date.description: Calendar date on which the macroeconomic indicator value was observed or published.

lpp.macro_indicator.value.name: value
lpp.macro_indicator.value.description: Numeric reading of the macroeconomic indicator for the given date and region, expressed in the units defined by the unit column.

lpp.macro_indicator.unit.name: unit
lpp.macro_indicator.unit.description: Unit of measurement for the indicator value, such as percentage (pct), index points (index), year-over-year percentage change (pct_yoy), or US dollars per barrel (usd_per_bbl).

lpp.macro_indicator.source.name: source
lpp.macro_indicator.source.description: Code identifying the data provider or institution that published the macroeconomic indicator, such as FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Bloomberg/BBAEP, Bureau of Labor Statistics, CME Group, or ICE.
value_aliases: FRED -> Federal Reserve Economic Data (St. Louis Fed)
FRBNY -> Federal Reserve Bank of New York
BBAEP -> Bloomberg/British Bankers Association Energy Prices

lpp.mapping_entry.mapping_table_code.name: mapping_table_code
lpp.mapping_entry.mapping_table_code.description: Code identifying which lookup/translation table this mapping entry belongs to, such as payment rail to AFP code, flow type to GL account, bank to BIC, or company to functional currency.
value_aliases: RAIL_TO_AFP -> Payment rail to AFP code mapping
FLOW_TO_GL -> Cash flow type to GL account mapping
BANK_TO_BIC -> Bank identifier to BIC/SWIFT code mapping
CO_TO_FUNCTIONAL_CCY -> Company to functional currency mapping

lpp.mapping_entry.source_value.name: source_value
lpp.mapping_entry.source_value.description: The input/source code or identifier being translated, such as a payment rail type (WIRE, ACH, SEPA_CT), bank identifier (BANK_JPM), or cash flow type (DISB_PAYROLL), depending on the mapping table.

lpp.mapping_entry.target_value.name: target_value
lpp.mapping_entry.target_value.description: The output/translated value produced by the mapping, which may be a GL account number, BIC/SWIFT code (e.g. CHASUS33), AFP transaction code, or ISO currency code (e.g. USD, EUR), depending on the mapping table.
value_aliases: BOFAUS3N -> Bank of America BIC/SWIFT code
ROYCCAT2 -> Royal Bank of Canada BIC/SWIFT code
SCBLSGSG -> Standard Chartered Bank BIC/SWIFT code

lpp.mapping_table.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.mapping_table.uuid.description: Universally unique identifier that serves as the primary key for each mapping table record.

lpp.mapping_table.code.name: code
lpp.mapping_table.code.description: Short machine-readable key identifying the type of mapping being defined, such as payment rail to AFP service code or internal bank code to BIC.
value_aliases: RAIL_TO_AFP -> Payment rail to AFP service code mapping
FLOW_TO_GL -> Cash flow code to GL account class mapping
BANK_TO_BIC -> Internal bank code to BIC mapping

lpp.wcf_document.due_date.name: due_date
lpp.wcf_document.due_date.description: Calendar date by which the working capital finance document is due for payment.

lpp.wcf_document.amount.name: amount
lpp.wcf_document.amount.description: Total monetary value of the working capital finance document in the document's stated currency.

lpp.wcf_document.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.wcf_document.currency_code.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the document amount is denominated (e.g. USD).

lpp.wcf_document.early_payment_terms_ref.name: early_payment_terms_ref
lpp.wcf_document.early_payment_terms_ref.description: Reference code identifying the early payment terms programme or agreement applied to the working capital finance document.

lpp.webhook_event.uuid.name: uuid
lpp.webhook_event.uuid.description: Unique identifier for each webhook event record.

lpp.webhook_event.event_type.name: event_type
lpp.webhook_event.event_type.description: Categorical code indicating the type of business event that triggered the webhook, such as a routing status change, document approval, batch status change, entity change, or execution completion.

lpp.webhook_event.entity_type.name: entity_type
lpp.webhook_event.entity_type.description: Classification of the business object associated with the webhook event, indicating the event pertains to a payment file.

lpp.webhook_event.entity_code.name: entity_code
lpp.webhook_event.entity_code.description: Unique UUID identifying the specific business entity instance (e.g., a payment file) that the webhook event is associated with.

lpp.webhook_event.payload.name: payload
lpp.webhook_event.payload.description: Full structured data payload delivered with the webhook event, containing the detailed context and attributes of the triggering event.

lpp.webhook_event.received_at.name: received_at
lpp.webhook_event.received_at.description: Timestamp recording when the webhook event was received by the system.

lpp.webhook_event.processed_at.name: processed_at
lpp.webhook_event.processed_at.description: Timestamp recording when the webhook event was fully processed by the system.

lpp.working_capital_metric.company_ref.name: company_ref
lpp.working_capital_metric.company_ref.description: Internal company entity code identifying a specific legal entity or subsidiary within the group (e.g. GR_TREASURY, GR_CA, GR_FR).

lpp.working_capital_metric.period_date.name: period_date
lpp.working_capital_metric.period_date.description: Month-end or quarter-end date representing the reporting period for which working capital metrics are calculated.

lpp.working_capital_metric.dso_days.name: dso_days
lpp.working_capital_metric.dso_days.description: Days Sales Outstanding — the average number of days it takes to collect payment after a sale has been made.

lpp.working_capital_metric.dpo_days.name: dpo_days
lpp.working_capital_metric.dpo_days.description: Days Payable Outstanding — the average number of days the entity takes to pay its suppliers after receiving an invoice.

lpp.working_capital_metric.dio_days.name: dio_days
lpp.working_capital_metric.dio_days.description: Days Inventory Outstanding — the average number of days inventory is held before being sold, reflecting inventory turnover efficiency.

lpp.working_capital_metric.ccc_days.name: ccc_days
lpp.working_capital_metric.ccc_days.description: Cash Conversion Cycle — the net number of days it takes to convert inventory and receivables investments into cash collected from customers, after accounting for payables.

lpp.working_capital_metric.ar_balance.name: ar_balance
lpp.working_capital_metric.ar_balance.description: Total outstanding accounts receivable balance owed to the entity by customers as of the reporting period.

lpp.working_capital_metric.ap_balance.name: ap_balance
lpp.working_capital_metric.ap_balance.description: Total outstanding accounts payable balance owed by the entity to its suppliers as of the reporting period.

lpp.working_capital_metric.revenue_ttm.name: revenue_ttm
lpp.working_capital_metric.revenue_ttm.description: Total revenue recognized over the trailing twelve months (TTM) ending on the reporting period date.

lpp.working_capital_metric.cogs_ttm.name: cogs_ttm
lpp.working_capital_metric.cogs_ttm.description: Total cost of goods sold over the trailing twelve months (TTM) ending on the reporting period date.

lpp.working_capital_metric.currency_code.name: currency_code
lpp.working_capital_metric.currency_code.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary values in the record are denominated (e.g. USD).

lpp.ach_return.description: Represents ACH (Automated Clearing House) return events where a previously initiated ACH transfer was rejected and returned by the receiving bank. Each record captures the return reason (using NACHA standard codes such as R01 for insufficient funds), the associated company entity, bank account, and monetary details. Key identifiers include uuid (primary key), original_transfer_ref (the originating transfer), company_ref, and bank_account_ref.
lpp.ach_return.table_type_reason: Each row is a discrete payment return event with amounts, dates, and reason codes — characteristic of a fact table, not a dimension.
lpp.ach_return.grain: One row per ACH return event received or processed against an original ACH transfer.

lpp.acquirer.description: Reference table of payment acquirers and processors used by the business to process card transactions. Each record describes a single acquirer entity including its internal code, full legal name, parent bank linkage, settlement account, geographic region, and strategic status. Key identifiers include uuid (primary key) and code (e.g. ADYEN, STRIPE, CHASE_PAYTECH).
lpp.acquirer.grain: One row per payment acquirer or processor onboarded to the platform.

lpp.acquirer_contract.description: Stores the contractual terms agreed between the business's legal entities and their payment acquirers, including pricing, SLA commitments, and contract lifecycle dates. Each record represents one contract between a specific internal company entity (e.g. GR_US_INC) and an acquirer (e.g. ADYEN, STRIPE), capturing terms such as processing margin in basis points, monthly minimums, settlement lag, and uptime SLAs. Key identifiers are uuid (primary key), acquirer_ref, and company_ref.
lpp.acquirer_contract.grain: One row per acquirer contract between a legal entity and a payment acquirer.

lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.description: Fact table recording daily SLA and operational performance metrics for each payment acquirer, used to monitor compliance against contractual commitments. Each record captures a specific acquirer's measured performance on a given date, including authorisation rate, average response time, settlement on-time rate, system uptime, SLA breach count, and incident count. Key identifiers are acquirer_ref and measurement_date, which together form the composite primary key.
lpp.acquirer_sla_metric.grain: One row per acquirer per measurement date capturing daily SLA and operational performance metrics.

lpp.ap_invoice.description: Represents accounts payable invoices received from vendors and suppliers across the group's legal entities, tracking the full payment lifecycle from issuance through to settlement. Each record corresponds to a single vendor invoice with amounts, dates, payment terms, and current status (PAID, OPEN, PARTIAL, DISPUTED). Key identifiers include uuid (primary key), invoice_number, vendor_ref, and company_ref.
lpp.ap_invoice.table_type_reason: Contains transactional monetary amounts (invoice_amount, paid_amount, open_amount), lifecycle dates, and status — characteristic of a fact table representing a business event/transaction rather than a descriptive dimension.
lpp.ap_invoice.grain: One row per accounts payable invoice issued by a vendor to an internal legal entity.

lpp.app_user.description: Represents application users within the treasury and finance platform, storing identity and access attributes for each named user. Each record corresponds to a single user account identified by a UUID, with a business role code (e.g. TREAS_FRONT, CFO_GLOBAL) indicating their function within the organisation. Key identifiers are uuid (primary key), code (role/function code), and email.
lpp.app_user.table_type_reason: Small static lookup table (15 rows) of named users and their role codes; serves as a reference list for other tables rather than a slowly-changing dimension in its own right.
lpp.app_user.grain: One row per application user account registered in the treasury and finance platform.

lpp.ar_invoice.description: Represents accounts receivable invoices issued by legal entities within the group to customers, capturing the full lifecycle from issuance through payment or write-off. Each record is a single invoice identified by a UUID and a human-readable invoice number encoding channel, issuing entity, and date. Key attributes include company_ref, customer_ref, issue/due/paid dates, invoice/paid/open amounts in the invoice currency, and status (PAID, OPEN, WRITTEN_OFF).
lpp.ar_invoice.table_type_reason: Contains transactional financial measures (invoice_amount, paid_amount, open_amount) and lifecycle dates across ~269k rows sorted by issue_date — clearly a fact table, not a dimension.
lpp.ar_invoice.grain: One row per accounts receivable invoice issued by a group legal entity to a customer.

lpp.audit_trail.description: Records a log of all audited actions performed on key treasury business objects such as bank accounts, transfers, hedge relationships, and liquidity policies. Each row captures a single audit event with the entity type and code affected, the action taken (CREATE, UPDATE, APPROVE), the user who performed it, and full before/after JSON snapshots of the entity state. Key identifiers are uuid (primary key), entity_type, entity_code, and occurred_at timestamp.
lpp.audit_trail.table_type_reason: Each row is a discrete timestamped event (an action performed by a user on an entity), making this an event/fact table rather than a dimension.
lpp.audit_trail.grain: One row per audited action performed on a treasury business entity.

lpp.bank.description: A reference directory of banking counterparties and financial institutions used by the organisation, storing static attributes such as BIC, LEI, risk tier, and exposure limits. Each record represents a single bank or financial counterparty identified by a UUID and an internal code (e.g. BANK_ANZ, BANK_CITI). Key identifiers are uuid (primary key), code, interface_code, and bic.
lpp.bank.table_type_reason: Very small table (14 rows) of static bank master data with BIC/LEI codes and exposure limits; functions as a reference lookup rather than a standard SCD dimension.
lpp.bank.grain: One row per banking counterparty or financial institution recognised in the treasury management system.

lpp.bank_account.description: A master register of all bank accounts held by group legal entities, capturing operational attributes, payment capabilities, cash pooling configuration, and GL mapping for each account. Each row represents a single bank account identified by a UUID and a structured business code (e.g. GR_AE_COLLECTION_1) that encodes the owning company and account purpose. Key identifiers are uuid (primary key), code, company_ref, branch_ref, and currency_ref.
lpp.bank_account.grain: One row per bank account held by a group legal entity.

lpp.bank_account_group.description: Represents a named grouping or category of bank accounts used for organisational, reporting, or cash management purposes. Each record defines a single bank account group with a short code and human-readable description. The primary key is a UUID, with the code serving as the business identifier.
lpp.bank_account_group.table_type_reason: This is a small lookup/reference table defining bank account group codes and descriptions with no measurable facts — better classified as reference than dimension.
lpp.bank_account_group.grain: One row per bank account group defined in the system.

lpp.bank_account_group_member.description: Represents the many-to-many relationship between bank account groups and their individual member bank accounts. Each record captures a single membership link, identifying which bank account belongs to which account group. The composite primary key is formed by the account_group_code and bank_account_code.
lpp.bank_account_group_member.grain: One row per bank account assigned to a bank account group.

lpp.bank_account_signatory.description: Records the authorised signatories and their signing authority on each bank account, capturing the user role, authority limit, and lifecycle dates including grant, recertification, and next due review date. Each record represents a single user's signing mandate on a specific bank account with a defined role such as SIGNER_A, SIGNER_B, or RELEASER. Key identifiers are uuid, bank_account_ref, and user_ref.
lpp.bank_account_signatory.table_type_reason: This is a slowly changing authority/mandate table describing who can sign on each account — a descriptive dimension rather than a static reference lookup.
lpp.bank_account_signatory.grain: One row per authorised signatory role assigned to a bank account.

lpp.bank_branch.description: Stores reference data for individual bank branches used by the organisation, including the parent bank, location details, SWIFT BIC, time zone, cut-off times, and operational flags. Each record represents a single physical or operational branch of a financial institution identifiable by a structured code (e.g. BR_ANZ_SYD). Key identifiers are uuid, code, and bic.
lpp.bank_branch.grain: One row per bank branch registered in the system.

lpp.bank_fee.description: Captures bank service fees charged to specific bank accounts per billing period, including the charged amount, expected amount from the agreed rate card, overage variance, and a flag for fees requiring review. Each record represents a single bank fee line item for a given service code, bank account, and statement period. Key identifiers are uuid, bank_account_ref, cash_flow_ref, and rate_card_ref.
lpp.bank_fee.table_type_reason: This table contains transactional measures (charged_amount, expected_amount, overage_amount, units) tied to a date and account — it is a fact table, not a reference table.
lpp.bank_fee.grain: One row per bank fee charge for a specific service code on a bank account within a statement period.

lpp.bank_group.description: This table represents a named grouping of banks used for organisational or reporting purposes. Each record defines a distinct bank group with a compact reference code and a full descriptive label. The primary key is a UUID, with the code serving as the human-facing identifier.
lpp.bank_group.table_type_reason: Purely descriptive lookup table defining bank group entities — classic dimension.

lpp.bank_group_member.description: This table captures the many-to-many relationship between bank groups and individual banks, recording which banks belong to which group. Each record is identified by the composite key of bank_group_code and bank_code. It acts as a bridge/association table enabling a bank to belong to one or more groups.
lpp.bank_group_member.grain: One row per bank-to-bank-group membership assignment.

lpp.bank_service_type.description: This table is a reference catalogue of bank service types, classifying the distinct services that a bank can provide or charge for. Each record defines a service by a short code, a human-readable description (e.g. 'Wire Out Domestic', 'ACH Credit'), and a broad functional category (e.g. WIRE_OUT, ACH, SEPA). With 25 rows it is a small, stable lookup used to categorise bank transactions and fees.
lpp.bank_service_type.table_type_reason: Small, stable catalogue of service type codes with descriptions — a reference lookup, not a transactional dimension.
lpp.bank_service_type.grain: One row per bank service type code.

lpp.bank_statement_balance.description: This table stores daily bank account balances as reported in bank statements or BAI-format bank feed files, covering opening, intraday, and closing positions for each account. Each record represents the balance of a specific bank account on a given statement date for a particular balance type, denominated in the account's native currency. Key identifiers are account_ref, statement_date, and balance_type, with data quality status flags indicating whether each record passed validation.
lpp.bank_statement_balance.table_type_reason: Stores measured monetary balances (amounts) over time per account and balance type — a periodic snapshot fact table, not a dimension.
lpp.bank_statement_balance.grain: One row per bank account, statement date, and balance type (opening, intraday, or closing).

lpp.benchmark_rate.description: This table stores published benchmark interest rate observations sourced from central banks, covering major rates such as SOFR, SONIA, ESTR, TONA, and TIIE across multiple currencies and tenors (overnight, 1-month, 3-month). Each record captures the annualised rate for a specific benchmark code, publication date, and tenor combination. It is used to support interest calculations, debt pricing, hedging, and investment analytics.
lpp.benchmark_rate.table_type_reason: Externally sourced, read-only rate data used as a lookup across multiple domains — a reference table rather than a transactional fact.
lpp.benchmark_rate.grain: One row per benchmark rate code, rate date, and tenor.

lpp.borrowing.description: Represents individual borrowing drawdowns made by group entities against credit facilities such as term loans, revolving credit facilities, intercompany lines, and overdrafts. Each row captures the lifecycle of a single draw, including the amount, currency, interest rate, drawdown and repayment dates, and current status. Key identifiers are uuid (primary key), facility_ref, and company_ref.
lpp.borrowing.table_type_reason: Each row is a transactional drawdown event with measures (principal_amount, all_in_rate) and lifecycle status — more fact-like than a dimension despite low row count.
lpp.borrowing.grain: One row per individual borrowing drawdown made by a group entity against a credit facility.

lpp.brain_evaluation.description: Records the audit trail of each reasoning-engine evaluation triggered by a user query, capturing the knowledge-graph traversal steps, seed facts, retrieved facts, detected conflicts, and the resulting answer summary. Each row corresponds to a single evaluation run executed by the AI reasoning engine on behalf of a user. Key identifiers are uuid and user_code.
lpp.brain_evaluation.table_type_reason: Each row is a discrete evaluation event with measurable attributes (expansion_hops, retrieval_scores) and timestamps — this is an event/fact table, not a reference table.
lpp.brain_evaluation.grain: One row per reasoning-engine evaluation run submitted by a user.

lpp.budget_code.description: A small reference lookup table defining the valid budget category codes used across the platform, such as operations, capital expenditure, tax, and treasury. Each row represents a single budget classification with its short code and human-readable description. The primary key is uuid, with code as the natural business key.
lpp.budget_code.grain: One row per budget category code.

lpp.capital_allocation_actual.description: Stores actual capital deployment amounts by legal entity, reporting period, and allocation bucket (e.g. CAPEX, M&A, dividends, debt paydown, buybacks), alongside the framework target percentage for each bucket. Each row represents the realised capital allocation for a specific company, quarter-end period, and deployment category. The composite key is company_ref + period_date + bucket.
lpp.capital_allocation_actual.table_type_reason: Contains periodic financial measures (amount, framework_target_pct) aggregated by entity, period, and bucket — this is a periodic snapshot fact table, not a reference table.
lpp.capital_allocation_actual.grain: One row per company, quarter-end period, and capital allocation bucket.

lpp.card_authorization.description: Captures every card authorization request and response processed through the acquiring infrastructure, including the decision outcome, decline reason, 3DS authentication status, device fingerprint, and response latency. Each row represents a single authorization attempt linked to a point-of-sale transaction, identified by uuid and pos_transaction_ref. Key dimensions include acquirer_ref, network_code, BIN, region, and CNP indicator.
lpp.card_authorization.table_type_reason: Each row is a discrete authorization event with measures (amount, response_time_ms) and a timestamped request/response lifecycle — clearly a transactional fact table.
lpp.card_authorization.grain: One row per card authorization request submitted to the payment network.

lpp.card_bin_range.description: This table is a reference lookup that maps contiguous ranges of 6-digit Bank Identification Numbers (BINs) to their associated card network, issuing bank, issuer country, and card product type. It is used to identify the issuer and product characteristics of any payment card from its first six digits. One row represents a single BIN range defined by a low and high BIN prefix, with uuid as the primary key.
lpp.card_bin_range.table_type_reason: Small static lookup table (22 rows) mapping BIN ranges to card network and issuer attributes; no measures or transactional data.
lpp.card_bin_range.grain: One row per contiguous range of BIN prefixes assigned to a specific card issuer and product type.

lpp.card_network.description: This table is a small reference list of all card payment networks and schemes supported by the platform, such as Visa, Mastercard, American Express, UnionPay, and private-label networks. It provides the canonical code, display name, and network type (credit, debit PIN, charge, private label) for each scheme. One row represents a single card payment network, keyed by its short code.
